digest.component_or_area: T11 migration plan review rubric (LLM reviewer)
propositions: T11 post-rollback findings are tautologies for append-only stores and generate excessive false positives (8 of 21 sampled) that obscure genuine data-loss bugs

The unconditional post-rollback paragraph must be replaced with a four-condition applicability rule that raises findings only when plans change record interpretation, rewrite records in place, remove/narrow read paths, or perform one-way transformations with no back-out
Purely additive backward-compatible persistence changes (new record types, optional fields, new tables/columns with defaults) must be explicitly excluded from triggering post-rollback findings
The applicability rule must not name store technology so it applies equally across SQL migrations, event stores, document databases, and config formats
